script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.plant_id,
       j.command,
       j.payload_hash,
       j.confirmation_hash,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at,
       j.lease_owner,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       j.cancel_requested,
       j.row_version,
       j.request_payload,
       j.prepared_payload,
       j.line_count,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS started_at,
       CAST(j.create_user AS CHAR) AS create_user,
       j.is_deleted,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_bulk_line_stage st
         WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}'
           AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.jobId}}'
           AND st.is_deleted = 0) AS stage_count
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT 'SETUP' AS kind, CAST(CAST(ps.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(ps.picking_mode AS CHAR) AS v1, CAST(ps.default_strategy_id AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(ps.split_policy AS CHAR) AS v3, CAST(ps.picking_after AS CHAR) AS v4, CAST(CAST(ps.picking_required AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q1, CAST(ps.full_cl_check AS CHAR) AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM (SELECT p.id, p.picking_mode, p.default_strategy_id, p.split_policy, p.picking_after, p.picking_required, p.full_cl_check
          FROM picking_setup p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND p.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 1) ps
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITEM' AS kind, CAST(CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(i.material_code AS CHAR) AS v1, CAST(CAST(i.item_batch_management AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(CAST(i.stock_control AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v3, CAST(CAST(i.show_delivery AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, CAST(CAST(COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.base_qty)) FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0), '[]') AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS j1, CAST(CAST(COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('plant_id', CAST(db.plant_id AS CHAR), 'bin_location', CAST(db.bin_location AS CHAR))) FROM item_wu520fpw_sub db WHERE db.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND db.Item_id = i.id AND db.is_deleted = 0), '[]') AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND i.id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) AND i.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CNT' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(c.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, 'item_balance' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM item_balance c
 WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND c.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND c.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY c.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CNT' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(c.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, 'item_batch_balance' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM item_batch_balance c
 WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND c.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND c.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY c.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'IBAL' AS kind, CAST(CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, CAST(CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q1, CAST(CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q2, CAST(CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q3, CAST(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 23) AS CHAR) AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM item_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) AND b.unrestricted_qty > 0
   AND b.material_id IN (SELECT c.material_id FROM item_balance c WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND c.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND c.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) GROUP BY c.material_id HAVING COUNT(*) < 500)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BBAL' AS kind, CAST(CAST(b.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, CAST(CAST(b.location_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS location_id, CAST(CAST(b.batch_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, CAST(CAST(b.unrestricted_qty AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q1, CAST(CAST(b.reserved_qty AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q2, CAST(CAST(b.balance_quantity AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q3, CAST(LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 23) AS CHAR) AS t1, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(b.expired_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CHAR) AS t2, CAST(DATE_FORMAT(b.manufacturing_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CHAR) AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) AND b.unrestricted_qty > 0
   AND b.material_id IN (SELECT c.material_id FROM item_batch_balance c WHERE c.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND c.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND c.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) GROUP BY c.material_id HAVING COUNT(*) < 500)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BIN' AS kind, CAST(CAST(x.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(x.bin_location_combine AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM (SELECT bl.id, bl.bin_location_combine
          FROM bin_location bl
         WHERE bl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND bl.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND bl.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND bl.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY bl.id LIMIT 500) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'UOM' AS kind, CAST(CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(u.uom_name AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM unit_of_measurement u
 WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND u.id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoUomIdsSql}}) AND u.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'BATCH' AS kind, CAST(CAST(bt.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(bt.batch_number AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM batch bt
 WHERE bt.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND bt.is_deleted = 0
   AND bt.id IN (SELECT b.batch_id FROM item_batch_balance b WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND b.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND b.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}}) AND b.unrestricted_qty > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HU' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(hi.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS n
  FROM handling_unit h
  JOIN handling_unit_atu7sreg_sub hi
    ON hi.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND hi.handling_unit_id = h.id AND hi.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND h.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND h.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0 AND (h.packing_id IS NULL OR h.packing_id = '') AND hi.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY hi.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'HURES' AS kind, '' AS id, CAST(CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Allocated' AND r.handling_unit_id IS NOT NULL AND r.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.autoMaterialIdsSql}})
 GROUP BY r.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PEND' AS kind, '' AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(CAST(r.parent_line_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v1, '' AS v2, '' AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM on_reserved_gd r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.organizationId}}' AND r.plant_id = {{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.plantId}} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Pending' AND r.parent_line_id IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soLineIdsQuoted}})
 GROUP BY r.parent_line_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LINK' AS kind, CAST(CAST(dl.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS CHAR) AS v1, CAST(dl.buyer_org_id AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(dl.seller_org_id AS CHAR) AS v3, '' AS v4, '' AS q1, '' AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM document_linkage dl
 WHERE dl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND dl.is_deleted = 0 AND dl.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND dl.link_status = 'Linked'
   AND CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS UNSIGNED) IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soIdsSql}})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITS' AS kind, CAST(CAST(its.id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS id, '' AS material_id, '' AS location_id, '' AS batch_id, '' AS v1, CAST(CAST(its.buyer_org_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v2, CAST(CAST(its.seller_org_id AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS v3, '' AS v4, CAST(CAST(its.auto_create_gr AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q1, CAST(CAST(its.skip_picking AS CHAR) AS CHAR) AS q2, '' AS q3, '' AS t1, '' AS t2, '' AS t3, '' AS j1, '' AS j2, 0 AS n
  FROM internal_trading_setup its
 WHERE its.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND its.is_deleted = 0 AND its.is_active = 1
   AND (its.buyer_org_id, its.seller_org_id) IN (SELECT CAST(dl.buyer_org_id AS UNSIGNED), CAST(dl.seller_org_id AS UNSIGNED)
                                                    FROM document_linkage dl
                                                   WHERE dl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_kYqf0Zfd.data.tenantId}}' AND dl.is_deleted = 0 AND dl.target_doc_type = 'Sales Order' AND dl.link_status = 'Linked'
                                                     AND CAST(dl.target_doc_id AS UNSIGNED) IN ({{node:code_node_FniXEIuQ.data.soIdsSql}}))
